name: PayRoll
title: Scoped payments and audit logging
notes: Added /payall command with scope support (all, police, statep, ambulance).
Implemented job and grade based payout calculation using QBX/QBCore job payments.
Enforced off-duty pay rules (offDutyPay) and blocked non-positive payouts.
Added bank deposit payouts with configurable default reason and optional reason override.
Added Discord audit logging for executor, totals, and paid player list.
Added export: PayPlayer(src, amount, reason) for use by other resources.
Added debug logging toggle via Config.Debug.
